settings.heading: Questions, answered straight
settings.text: Anything else? Send me a message and I will answer within a working day.

settings.question: Who do you work with?
settings.answer: Owners of companies with roughly two to twenty people: shops, studios, agencies, trades and services. If you are just starting out, the Growth Sprint is a good first step.

settings.question: What happens on the free call?
settings.answer: Twenty minutes on video. You tell me where the business is stuck, I ask a few questions, and I say honestly whether I can help. There is no pitch at the end.

settings.question: How long do clients usually stay?
settings.answer: Most stay four to six months on monthly coaching. You can stop or pause any month, with no notice period.

settings.question: Do you work in person?
settings.answer: Monthly coaching and the Growth Sprint are on video. Strategy days can be in person in Austin, at your place for a travel fee, or online.

settings.question: Can my business pay for it?
settings.answer: Yes. You get an invoice in the company's name for every payment.

settings.question: What if it is not working?
settings.answer: Tell me. If after the first month you feel it is not worth it, I refund that month.

settings.heading: From the first call to a plan you use
settings.text: No long questionnaire and no theory. We work on your real numbers and your real calendar from week one.

settings.title: A free call
settings.text: You tell me where the business is stuck. I tell you honestly whether I can help, and how.

settings.title: Look at the numbers
settings.text: Sales, margins, cash and where your hours go. One page that shows what is really happening.

settings.title: Pick three changes
settings.text: Not twenty. Three changes with the most effect, each with an owner and a date.

settings.title: Do the work, check in
settings.text: We meet, look at what moved and what did not, and adjust. You keep the plan between calls.

settings.heading: Let's look at your week
settings.text: Twenty minutes on video. You say where the business is stuck; I say whether I can help.
settings.note: No pitch. If we are not a fit, I will say so.
